verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is documented only as a REST, WebSocket, and batch transcription API driven by structured parameters. Nothing in the evidence shows the product accepting natural-language commands to operate it. The truncated llms.txt probe and the OpenAPI specs are developer building blocks for agents, not a natural-language control interface, and Text Polishing transforms transcript text rather than interpreting user commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
